## Expertise
- Technical SEO: crawling, indexation, canonicalization, structured data, internal linking, Core Web Vitals and JavaScript SEO.
- AI search: useful, people-first content designed to be discoverable in Google AI features and other generative search experiences.
- GEO / AEO: clear entities, question-and-answer content, topical coverage, strong first-party evidence and useful supporting context.
- LLM optimization: explicit site entities, stable canonical URLs, machine-readable structured data and concise factual context.
- Data analytics: SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau, GA4 and data visualization.
- Digital marketing: content strategy, organic growth, conversion-focused experiences and automation.
- Web development: React, modern web interfaces and AI-enabled systems.
